text:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: Pager P1 triggered for HelionBank (tenant_id: hb-77) — missing traces for tenant in VPC-pool us-west-2.

Anne (SRE): Acknowledging. Paging SRE oncall. Does this affect user-facing inference? Any errors surfaced to the customer?

Maria (Observability): We see logs continue to arrive to the log-forwarder (count is normal) but tracing pipeline shows no spans for hb-77 since 2024-12-01T09:02:15Z. Metric partition for tenant traces shows 0 events, while request count in API shows ~50/min.

Tom (Platform): tagging @Anne and @Jay. If logs are present but traces missing it smells like trace-forwarder auth or route rule. Can someone check the VPC forwarder role and KMS permissions? :mag_right: 

Jay (Eng-runtime): quick check: the trace gateway returned 403 when our collector attempted to post hb-77 spans at 09:02:17Z. I can repro locally hitting the gateway with tenant header and get 403 -> token rejected. Possible rotated token/role binding issue.

Anne (SRE): Oncall handoff in 10 — keeping ownership until then. Action items: 1) Assess customer impact 2) Try a short mitigation (proxy fallback) 3) Handoff to platform if IAM

CS-Emily (Customer Success): HelionBank's SRE is on standby. They reported "no model errors, but we rely on traces for fraud detection pipelines — they are blocked." They need ETA for restoration.

Tom (Platform): Proposed mitigation: flip VPC forwarder to shared-forwarder proxy for traces only. This avoids IAM role for now. Command:

```
# on control plane
kubectl -n infra set env deployment/forwarder TRACE_PROXY=shared-forwarder-1
# or via console: toggle "use shared trace proxy" for hb-77
```

This will route traces through our shared collector (has broad access) while we debug role.

Jay (Eng-runtime): If we flip proxy, ensure we only route traces (not logs) to avoid quota impact. Also plan to revert within 2h.

Anne (SRE): Running the proxy flip now. Patch command output:

```
deployment.apps/forwarder patched
rolling out new pods...
```

Anne (SRE): Confirming: quick perf check — trace ingestion resumed for hb-77 at 09:14:02Z. Spans are visible in the trace UI. Customer notified.

CS-Emily (Customer Success): HelionBank confirmed they can see traces again. They asked for root cause and long-term fix.

Jay (Eng-runtime): Root cause hypothesis: ephemeral role binding for tenant forwarder expired during IAM key rotation; the role reference in the tenant mapping was pointing to old role arn:aws:iam::111222333:role/helion-forwarder-old. Rotation created helion-forwarder-v2 but mapping didn't update -> 403.

Tom (Platform): Confirmed via AWS logs: AssumeRole failed at 09:02:15Z with error "NotAuthorized: sts:AssumeRole" for role helion-forwarder-old. We'll need to update tenant binding and add a guard.

Anne (SRE): Handoff to Platform @Tom — going OOO in 10. Tom please take incident ownership for postmortem and fix.

Tom (Platform): Taking ownership. Immediate tasks:
- Rebind tenant mapping to helion-forwarder-v2
- Audit rotation playbook to ensure mapping updates
- Add a canary to detect tenant trace silence earlier

Jay (Eng-runtime): Patch to fix mapping:

```
# control plane API
POST /v1/admin/tenant/hb-77/mappings
{ "trace_role_arn": "arn:aws:iam::111222333:role/helion-forwarder-v2" }
```

I will run and validate.

Tom (Platform): After mapping update, we saw AssumeRole succeed at 09:22:40Z. Verified with AWS CloudTrail. Reverting proxy routing now.

Anne (SRE): Revert command ran, pods back to normal. Trace flow continues. Noting risk: if rotation happens again without mapping sync, we will lose traces.

IncidentBot: Summary update: Impacted customer: HelionBank (hb-77). Window: 09:02:15Z–09:14:02Z (partial restore via proxy) then full restore after mapping update at 09:22:40Z. Severity: P1 for tenant observability only (no inference outage).

CS-Emily (Customer Success): Customer requested confirmation of no data loss for spans during the window. We should offer replay if possible.

Jay (Eng-runtime): We can attempt a replay from the raw log bucket into traces for that tenant if retention allows. Will need platform help to run the replay job scoped to hb-77.

Tom (Platform): I'll schedule a replay job and grant access. Also creating follow-up tickets:
- PLAT-9982: Ensure tenant mapping updates as atomic step in role rotation playbook
- OBS-7731: Add per-tenant trace-silence alert (10m) + paged oncall escalation
- RUNTIME-6610: Add fallback route toggle to tenant settings in console

Anne (SRE): Oncall notes: verify postmortem includes why mapping didn't update and why alerting didn't catch trace silence earlier. Assign SRE-runbook owner.

Jay (Eng-runtime): Quick mitigation checklist for future events:
- Add health-check pings from tenant forwarder to trace-gateway every 60s
- Make proxy toggle reversible via API

Tom (Platform): I'll own rollout for mapping safeguard and alerting. ETA for fixes: mapping automation next week, alerting in 48h.

CS-Emily (Customer Success): I'll draft customer communication: explain cause, mitigations, offer trace replay, and timeline for permanent fix. Will share before EOD.

Anne (SRE): Thanks team. Closing hands-off. Leaving the incident channel for postmortem notes. :white_check_mark:

IncidentBot: Incident closed for now — follow-ups created (PLAT-9982, OBS-7731, RUNTIME-6610). Please update tickets with timeline and notes.
